title: NIST CSF 2.0 Functions
description: Interactive SVG wheel of the six NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 functions - GOVERN at the hub overseeing IDENTIFY, PROTECT, DETECT, RESPOND, and RECOVER - with hover tooltips and a responsive vertical-list fallback on narrow screens.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Name the six functions of NIST CSF 2.0 and the role of each.
Explain why GOVERN was added in 2024 and how it relates to the five operational functions.
Describe the cyclical Identify -> Protect -> Detect -> Respond -> Recover flow.
educational.prerequisites: Awareness that organizations manage cybersecurity as an ongoing program.

pedagogical.assessment: Discussion questions in the lesson plan ask students to place activities under the correct function and reason about GOVERN's oversight role.
misconceptionsAddressed: Thinking the framework is a linear checklist rather than a continuous cycle.
Treating governance as separate from, rather than overseeing, the technical functions.
